resources.string: InstaGuard monitors social media foreground time to enforce a 1-hour active usage limit and 5-hour cooldown lock period for your digital wellbeing.
InstaGuard is actively protecting your screen time.
Complete the permission setup below to activate protection.
Allows querying precise foreground screen time.
Allows instant detection and lock screen enforcement when tracked apps launch.
Enables impenetrable system defense to completely block floating Picture-in-Picture windows.

If Android blocks Accessibility as a "Restricted setting":
1. Open Android Settings > Apps > InstaGuard.
2. Tap the ⋮ (three dots) in top-right corner.
3. Tap "Allow restricted settings" & authenticate.
4. Return here and tap "2. Enable Accessibility Service".
Test Mode (1 Min Limit / 2 Min Lock)
Quick 60s allowance with 120s cooldown lock for immediate testing
1-Hour limit reached. Take a 5-Hour focus break.
Cooldown completed. You may now return.
